title: Down the Sinkhole
html:
Abel Munt's partner, Bram Kettle, went down the sinkhole into the Antlion Hive six years ago and never came up.

About

Given byAbel Munt
Level25
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Partners Lamp ×1
  • Partners Pick ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Abel Munt to get the quest.
  2. Go down the sinkhole into the and kill 12 Antlion Pitlings or Antlions on the upper floors. A pitling drops Bram’s lamp.
  3. Bring the lamp to Abel Munt.
  4. Go deeper and kill 8 Antlion Warriors on the lower floors.
  5. At the very bottom, kill the Antlion Queen (). She drops Bram’s pick.
  6. Bring the pick to Abel Munt to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold3,200
Character XP100,000
Quest points1

What Abel Munt says

Abel Munt: B, R, A, M. He scratched that in with a nail the night we bought it.

Abel Munt: You found it near the top? Then something knocked it out of his hand and he kept going down in the dark. That's Bram. Stubborn.

Abel Munt: His pick will be wherever he stopped. It has cord wrapped around the handle, same as mine. We cut both off one coil. Go to the bottom if you have to, and mind the warriors on the lower floors.

Abel Munt: That's his cord. Same coil as mine, see?

Abel Munt: All the way at the bottom, with her. He always said the good stuff was deeper.

Abel Munt: Six years I've wondered. Knowing is better.

Abel Munt: I'll hang his pick and his lamp over my pile. Here, take this. I put it aside for whoever finally told me.

Handing it in
